explanation: Jacket corresponds to gauze: In this analogy, a jacket is a piece of clothing used to protect the body from cold, while gauze is a medical supply used to protect wounds from infection. Both serve a protective function.

Zipper corresponds to suture: A zipper is a tool used to connect the two sides of a jacket, while suture is the process of connecting the two sides of a wound. Both represent the act of connecting separated parts.
Cold corresponds to painful: Both cold and pain are discomforts that people wish to avoid.

background.source: A jacket is a versatile piece of clothing that can serve as both a fashion statement and protective gear against the cold. It is an upper body garment that is typically fastened at the front using a zipper, buttons, or hook-and-loop closures. The purpose of a jacket is to provide warmth and insulation, but it can also be worn for style and fashion. Jackets come in various designs and styles, ranging from the classic denim jacket to the more formal blazer. Some jackets are waterproof and windproof, making them ideal for outdoor activities or weather conditions. In colder climates, a jacket is an essential piece of clothing to keep the body warm and comfortable. It can be worn over layers of clothing or as a standalone piece depending on the temperature. Whether you are dressing up for a night out or running errands on a chilly day, a jacket is a great addition to any wardrobe.
background.target: A wound can happen at any time and can be caused by a variety of factors. It is a condition that arises from a rapid onset of injury, which leaves the skin lacerated or punctured (open wound) or bruised (closed wound). Depending on the severity, a wound may require immediate medical attention. Professionals use various methods to treat wounds, including sutures or stitches, to hold the wound together to facilitate healing. If not properly attended, wounds can be infected, posing a risk for further complications. Thus, it is essential to keep wounds clean and apply the proper first aid to prevent infections. Despite the severity of the wound, the human body possesses a natural ability to heal through the wound healing process.
